sources.quote: As a result of our efficiency improvements, we are also lowering the price of these models to $2 / 1M input tokens and $10 / 1M output tokens.
sources.supports: xAI announced Grok 2-1212 at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, but this does not state cached-token rates or the 2025 cache-field change.
Current xAI management API documentation shows a zero cached-prompt price for the grok-2-1212 model object; it does not establish the historical cache price as of June 2025.

notes: The provider announcement establishes the $2/$10 standard rates, while current API documentation shows a zero cached-prompt rate. Neither source establishes what cache-read or cache-write rates were during the earlier recorded period, and the Internet Archive CDX endpoint was temporarily offline when checked, so the classification and timing remain unclear.
